origins.section: The Same Rule Can Be Written as One Aggregated Row or as One Row per Year
Two Forms That Allow the Same Plans Can Have Different LP Bounds
Disaggregated Is Stronger, Not Always Bigger

gates.says: all 3 of this quiz's answerable readings held and each was taken over the question as it stands

recorded.prompt:q-same-plans: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.pass:q-same-plans: page reader (independent agent; saw the lesson pages and the question)
recorded.outcome:q-same-plans: "With binary x the two allow exactly the same plans."; "Same MILP optimum, $12,511k."
recorded.prompt:q-why-weaker: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.pass:q-why-weaker: page reader (independent agent; saw the lesson pages and the question)
recorded.outcome:q-why-weaker: "In the aggregated row the child is only 19.1% funded, so the big-M term M(1 - 0.191) is large enough to excuse any timing at all ... the row that allows it is the big-M timing row."
recorded.prompt:q-choose: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.pass:q-choose: page reader (independent agent; saw the lesson pages and the question)
recorded.outcome:q-choose: "Before choosing the smaller form, check what it costs in bound. A model that is a little bigger and solves in a tenth of the nodes is the better model."; summary: "weigh that against the bound".

recorded.prompt:q-same-plans:a: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.pass:q-same-plans:a: page reader (independent agent; saw the lesson pages and the question)
recorded.outcome:q-same-plans:a: "With binary x the two allow exactly the same plans"; same MILP optimum.
recorded.prompt:q-same-plans:b: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.pass:q-same-plans:b: page reader (independent agent; saw the lesson pages and the question)
recorded.outcome:q-same-plans:b: Same passage: same plans, same MILP optimum 12,511.
recorded.prompt:q-same-plans:c: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.pass:q-same-plans:c: page reader (independent agent; saw the lesson pages and the question)
recorded.outcome:q-same-plans:c: The forms give "Different LP bounds" and the aggregated LP admits points the cumulative does not, so the solver is not treating them as one form; the page gives same plans as the reason.
recorded.prompt:q-why-weaker:a: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.pass:q-why-weaker:a: page reader (independent agent; saw the lesson pages and the question)
recorded.outcome:q-why-weaker:a: "The funding row holds (parent and child are both at 19.1%) ... the row that allows it is the big-M timing row."
recorded.prompt:q-why-weaker:b: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.pass:q-why-weaker:b: page reader (independent agent; saw the lesson pages and the question)
recorded.outcome:q-why-weaker:b: The cumulative LP blocks the same one-year lag ("so P023 gets nothing"); what allowed it is the big-M term.
recorded.prompt:q-why-weaker:d: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.pass:q-why-weaker:d: page reader (independent agent; saw the lesson pages and the question)
recorded.outcome:q-why-weaker:d: "the objective only explains why the LP wants the early start; the row that allows it is the big-M timing row"
recorded.prompt:q-choose:a: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.pass:q-choose:a: page reader (independent agent; saw the lesson pages and the question)
recorded.outcome:q-choose:a: "Before choosing the smaller form, check what it costs in bound." Row count alone is not the test.
recorded.prompt:q-choose:b: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.pass:q-choose:b: page reader (independent agent; saw the lesson pages and the question)
recorded.outcome:q-choose:b: Same MILP plan is partly true, but "Two forms that allow the same plans can have different LP bounds" and you should check the bound before choosing.
recorded.prompt:q-choose:c: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.pass:q-choose:c: page reader (independent agent; saw the lesson pages and the question)
recorded.outcome:q-choose:c: "A tighter LP bound means a smaller search"; cumulative rows are "never weaker" - big-M rows are not faster on the page's account.
